title: Dual-Spectral Acoustic Siren STFT Engine & Urban Noise Filtering
objective: Design and verify real-time 2048-point STFT acoustic siren analysis at 22,050 Hz sampling rate, extracting energy density across 600-1600 Hz with harmonic peak consistency and threshold R_siren > 0.40.
acceptance_criteria: Process 22.05 kHz audio streams in sub-10ms FFT sliding windows.
Filter vehicle horns and urban background noise using harmonic peak consistency.
Achieve emergency siren verification with zero false triggers on ambient traffic noise.
Unit and integration test suites passing with 100% assertion coverage.

metadata.research_query: Dual-spectral acoustic siren detection STFT urban noise
